notes.text: The linked Bekhorot has Rabbi Yishmael ben Sitriel testify before Rabbi, as [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2262&lang=en) also records. Heilprin reports a different spelling from Yalkut.
